violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: Observed bottles and spoons used for food not sanitized before use and after cleaning due to no chlorine on site.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. PIC washed, rinsed, and sanitized all equipment.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: observed cooked beef patty at 46F, cooked chicken breast at 45F in 2 DR UR in storage area; cut watermelon at 46F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC discarded items.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: observed 2 DR UR in storage area at 50F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. Please contact a certified technician to repair unit. EHS will conduct a follow-up inspection within 10 days.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions. Observed no bleach test kit at the start of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a BLEACH test kit. PIC ordered test strips during the inspection.

violations.title: Availability of Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There are no chemical sanitizers for sanitizing equipment and utensils available in the establishment. Observed no sanitizer available on site at the start of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Except for those that are generated on-site, at the time of use, chemical sanitizers that are used to sanitize equipment and utensils shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation. PIC purchased chlorine during inspection and set up 3 compartment sink. MUNCH AND MATCH (Inspection Date: 09/02/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Sewage and waste water properly disposed

violations.title: Backflow Prevention between Sewage System & Food Equip
violations.observation: A direct connection exists between the drain line of the sanitizing basin of the 3-compartment sink and the sewer line. Observed a direct connection between the sanitizing basin and the 3-compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: A direct connection may not exist between the sewage system and a drain originating from equipment in which food, portable equipment, or utensils are placed. Please contact a certified plumber to install an air gap between the sanitizer basin and the sewer line.
